originalTitle: Moment family rescued after 16 hours floating on jet ski off Thailand
summary: A 50-year-old father and his two sons were found floating off Koh Samui island, a local official told AFP on Saturday.
content:
A 50-year-old father and his two sons have been rescued after they were found adrift off the Thai island of Koh Samui, a local official told AFP on Saturday.

They had spent more than 16 hours floating at sea after their jet ski capsized, local government official Amorn Chomchoey said.

"We found the exhausted after swallowing a lot of seawater," he told the news agency, adding "they were pale, especially the boys".

The family were checked in hospital after being rescued and were discharged shortly afterwards, Chomchoey told AFP.
chineseTitle: 一家人在泰国海域乘坐摩托艇漂流16小时后获救
chineseSummary: 当地官员周六告诉法新社，一名 50 岁的父亲和他的两个儿子被发现漂浮在苏梅岛附近。
chineseContent:
当地官员周六告诉法新社，一名 50 岁的父亲和他的两个儿子被发现在泰国苏梅岛附近漂流，现已获救。

当地政府官员阿莫恩·乔姆乔伊 (Amorn Chomchoey) 表示，他们的摩托艇倾覆后，他们在海上漂流了 16 个多小时。

他告诉新闻机构：“我们发现他们吞下大量海水后精疲力尽，”他补充道，“他们脸色苍白，尤其是男孩们”。

乔姆乔伊告诉法新社，一家人获救后在医院接受检查，不久就出院了。
